subject: Israel vendor onboarding: VAT registration & invoice format for PO activation
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Lina Duarte <lina.duarte@azerai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Israel vendor onboarding: VAT registration & invoice format for PO activation

Hi Lina,

Thanks for taking the time today — excited to get Azerai set up in our system so we can issue POs quickly. To make sure Procurement and Finance can activate the vendor record and process the first PO, we need the following items from your side: 

- Official Israeli VAT registration / VAT certificate (supplier TIN / VAT number)
- A sample invoice template showing the VAT line broken out (total, taxable base, VAT %) in English and ILS or USD
- Legal company name exactly as it appears on the VAT certificate and bank account (for PO matching)
- Bank wiring details (IBAN/Account number, SWIFT, beneficiary name). If you have an IBAN-equivalent PDF please attach.
- Completed Redwood vendor onboarding form (link below) so we have remittance address, tax residence, and W-8/W-9 not applicable notes for non-US vendors

I've attached our vendor form to this message and included Monica (Procurement) so she can start the vendor creation once we have the docs. Typical timeline on our side is vendor creation + PO issuance within 2 business days of receiving all docs. 

Drive form: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cRedwoodVendorForm

Could you reply with the VAT certificate and a sample invoice by end of day Tuesday Israel time? If invoices will be issued in ILS, please confirm whether you will charge VAT on top or include VAT in the gross amount (we need a separate VAT line).

Best,

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
[Attachment: Redwood-Vendor-Onboarding-Form.pdf (PDF)]

Bank details are attached in a separate PDF. Please note our bank prefers receiving USD via SWIFT; we can also accept ILS if you indicate that preference on the PO.

We will complete your vendor onboarding form this afternoon and upload the signed PDF. Let me know if you need any notarized translations — we have certified English copies of the VAT certificate.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Lina Duarte <lina.duarte@azerai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-16T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Israel vendor onboarding: VAT registration & invoice format for PO activation

Hi Lina — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Confirmed we received: IL-VAT-Certificate.pdf, Sample-Invoice-IL.pdf, and Azerai-Bank-Details.pdf. A few quick clarifications from Finance & Procurement so we can move to PO activation: 

1) Invoice requirements for Redwood to pay a PO: 
   - Invoice must include: vendor legal name, vendor address, Israeli VAT number (exact format), invoice number, date, description of services tied to PO line(s), taxable base, VAT amount and rate, and total due.
   - Currency: we can accept USD or ILS. If USD, please provide the currency and exchange indication on the invoice. If ILS, indicate the VAT line in ILS.

2) For cross-border services: please confirm whether the VAT is charged under domestic VAT rules or if a reverse-charge applies for services rendered to a non-resident customer (we ask so Finance can assess VAT reclaimability). If you believe reverse-charge applies, please point us to the tax guidance you are relying on.

3) Bank fields: Finance needs the beneficiary name to match the legal entity on the VAT certificate. Please confirm the account is in the company name and provide IBAN / account number and SWIFT.

4) Vendor form: we still need the completed Redwood vendor onboarding form (link below) signed by an authorized signer. That completes the PO workflow in our system.

Once those items are confirmed, Monica will submit for vendor creation and aim to issue the initial PO within 48 business hours. Aditya (copied) will do a quick tax check on the reverse-charge note.

Thanks — I’m available on a short call if that helps.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-Vendor-Onboarding-Form.pdf (PDF)]

Drive form: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cRedwoodVendorForm
